//: Configuration for nettriage-fulfilment. Copy to ~/.nettriage-fulfilment/config.json and fill in.
Every secret is referenced by PATH, never by value: this file can sit next to the keys without
becoming a secret itself. Run `nettriage-fulfilment check` after editing.

mail.//: mode 'file' writes the exact message to a directory instead of sending it. Use it to rehearse.

licence.//: Grace days are added on top of the paid period so a renewal that settles a day late never locks anyone out.
